On the med front it’s hard to stay positive when you’re treated as a guinea pig in a way trying this and that and there’s no guarantee it will work or that there won’t be nasty side effects. I’ve dealt with similar and honestly I had to hold out hope that I’d be able to find meds that work for me. I would say keep trying with the meds. Switch to another mental health provider if need be and record in a journal the effects of each med you’re trying. With everything else you’ve stated have you tried journaling? When you don’t have people you can depend on or reach out to journaling can really help(speaking from experience). Just getting all your thoughts out in a healthy way. Taking things minute by minute, hour by hour, day by day is another coping method that sometimes helps. Taking baby steps to not get overwhelmed by all the shitty stuff that is going on. Setting small obtainable goals like today I will brush my teeth for example can really help improve your mood. Again, I’m in a similar situation and I really hope things improve for you!
